title: Group Project Attachment
scenario: A teammate you barely know sends a file titled 'final presentation' from a personal link.

answers.A: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.B: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.
answers.C: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.D: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.

explanation: Group Project Attachment: the trap is to move you from a trusted channel to a fake page. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Unexpected files should be scanned and verified before opening.
